rationale: Reject. Product identity may be removed, but the raw kits encode protected model structures: RBT-24 is an explicit endothelial/pericyte/astrocyte triple co-culture, MBT-24H an endothelial/pericyte co-culture, and RTU endothelial cells without an explicit support-cell configuration. The proposed common `bbb kit` label erases these assay/model distinctions; because adjudication cannot rewrite the proposal, the merge must be rejected.

Accept. Independent raw-evidence review confirms that the proposed merge preserves the explicit passive-permeability assay/model, mechanism, direction, barrier state, and species evidence relevant to this decision. Species, named protocol, and cell-clone wording do not change the explicit triple co-culture model type. The checker independently agreed and found no unsupported inference or lost protected dimension: All 26 raw assignments explicitly describe a three-cell BBB/NVU co-culture. The decision retains the triple co-culture model type and in-vitro setting while removing only species, cell-clone, support, and named-protocol variation; no transport direction, disruption state, or distinct modality is collapsed.
